ar_blind_man_s_bluff.blurb: Blind Man's Bluff is a stretch of cliff on the southeast side of The Throne, part of the Sam's Throne complex in north-central Arkansas. All seven climbs here are traditional leads, running from easy 5.6 territory up to the low 5.11 range, with a pair at 5.10 along the way. The sandstone is good quality and the wall faces northeast. The cliffline wraps around a corner and finishes at a slabby wall. To find it, go left where the path splits in the Throne area, beyond the standalone formation called the Throne Proper.

ar_hair_lip_boulder.blurb: Hair lip boulder is a small bouldering spot at Lower Pilots Knob, near Pilots Knob in the Buffalo River region of north-central Arkansas. It holds seven problems, described as short, steep and powerful. The grades start at an easy V0, cluster around V4 with three problems there, and top out with one hard problem near V7. Most of the bouldering in the Lower Pilots Knob area sits close to where you park. On the main trail, the boulder is the first turn left after the high V0 arete.

ar_cool_breeze_area.blurb: Cool Breeze Area is a small section of Cave Creek, in the Sam's Throne region of north-central Arkansas, built around a big cave called Breeze Way on the main bluffline. Six sport routes and one trad route span roughly 5.8 to 5.11. The rock is of lower quality than much of the crag, with a band of choss low down on the pillar-like feature that holds the first routes. The wall faces mostly south, so it sees full sun in the middle of the day with shade early and late. Reach it by the downclimb or dog-walk approach, then head east past Brick Attack, Flat Fields and Stems and Seeds.
